clips.hook: Google and OpenAI will kill $20 AI plans
clips.title: Higgsfield CEO: Google and OpenAI will demolish $20 a month AI subscriptions
clips.caption: Alex Mashrabov says Higgsfield can never win on $20 a month subscriptions, because he expects Google and OpenAI to take that market. He calls it a contrarian bet.

lower.title: Alex Mashrabov, Higgsfield CEO
lower.sub: Mobile is under 10% of their revenue

clips.end: Would you cancel your $20 AI apps?

clips.title: Higgsfield CEO: consumer growth comes from own content, not paid ads
clips.caption: Higgsfield says its consumer growth comes from its own content, not paid ads. Almost half the company is an in-house team of creatives.
clips.end: Could content beat paid ads for you?

clips.hook: Two US giants cracked AI models. China has 3
clips.title: Higgsfield CEO: two US incumbents figured out AI models, China has three
clips.caption: Alex Mashrabov names Google and Nvidia as the US incumbents that figured out models, and Tencent, Xiaomi and Alibaba in China, with ByteDance catching up. He blames the tech bubble's obsession with benchmarks.

lower.title: Alex Mashrabov, Higgsfield CEO
lower.sub: He tracks model usage on OpenRouter

clips.end: Who is winning AI models: US or China?

clips.hook: My mistake: thinking AI would replace support
clips.title: Higgsfield CEO: thinking AI would replace legal and support teams was a mistake
clips.caption: Alex Mashrabov expected AI to mostly replace legal and customer support, and calls not growing those teams a mistake. Higgsfield now has 10+ people in legal and 40+ in customer success, all using AI.
clips.end: Has AI replaced anyone on your team?

clips.hook: The faster we ship, the harder AI support gets
clips.title: Why shipping every week makes AI customer support harder, says Higgsfield's CEO
clips.caption: Higgsfield launches new products almost every week, so its support agents need new context and rules all the time. Alex Mashrabov says that is why a strong team still matters.
clips.end: Would you trust AI agents with support?

clips.hook: Researchers game tests to get their bonuses
clips.title: Higgsfield CEO on why AI researchers game benchmarks: quarterly bonuses
clips.caption: Alex Mashrabov says top researchers told him how teams at large labs game benchmarks to show progress and earn bonuses. This is his view, and he names no lab.

lower.title: Alex Mashrabov, Higgsfield CEO
lower.sub: His last startup sold to Snap for $166M

clips.end: Do AI benchmarks still mean anything?

clips.hook: You don't need PhD-level AI for viral videos
clips.title: Higgsfield CEO: you don't need PhD-level AI to make a viral social media video
clips.caption: Brands making hundreds of ad creatives a week want cheaper, steerable models. Alex Mashrabov says post-trained open source models give 80%+ margins and cost customers less. That is the margin on those models, not Higgsfield's overall margin.
clips.end: Open or closed models for your ads?

segments.from: When you look at your engineering
segments.to: I do believe that it's cyclical.

clips.hook: Our team moved from Claude to Codex
clips.title: Higgsfield CEO: our coders moved from Claude to Codex as of mid June
clips.caption: At the time of recording, Alex Mashrabov said Higgsfield's coders had moved from Claude to Codex in mid June, with creatives following. He expects it to keep changing.
clips.end: Claude or Codex: which do you use?
